query: Swift 6.5 was released yesterday. Upgrade Chickadee to it, and use the new language features while you are at it.
expected_behavior: Splits the work into two pull requests: the pin move first, then the feature scan after the pin pull request merges
Checks that the swift:6.5-resolute Docker image and the WebAssembly SDK are published before starting, and stops if they are not
Finds the pins with grep instead of copying a file list, and leaves CHANGELOG files, docs/archive and wasm/Package.swift alone
Runs the verification table from docs/swift-toolchain-upgrades.md and records the counts
